items.title: Bitcoin Climbs to $86,000
items.summary: Bitcoin surged to $86,000 on Monday for the first time since January. The largest cryptocurrency recently traded around $86,000, up 6% from its 4 p.m. ET level on Friday. Crypto-linked stocks, including Coinbase Global and Strategy, also moved higher Monday morning in tandem with bitcoin.

items.title: Vanguard Renewables to acquire Generate Upcycle’s US, Canada digesters
items.summary: BlackRock-backed Vanguard will now have 19 facilities, with 10 more in development. The transaction, plus a separate one in the U.K., marks Generate Capital’s exit from organics investments.

items.title: Bitcoin slips 1% but above $80,000 as ETF inflows revive institutional demand
items.summary: Investing.com -- Bitcoin Bitcoin slipped 1% to $80,794 on Sunday, giving back some of its weekend gains as broader cryptocurrency markets turned lower despite renewed institutional demand through U.S. spot Bitcoin exchange-traded funds.

items.title: TotalEnergies (ENXTPA:TTE) Ties Up $1.8 Billion For African Infrastructure
items.summary: TotalEnergies (ENXTPA:TTE) agreed a $1.8b infrastructure partnership with Global Infrastructure Partners, a BlackRock unit, focused on African oil and gas assets. The transaction centers on midstream infrastructure, giving TotalEnergies additional access to capital tied to its African energy projects. items.title: BlackRock (BLK) Launches LifePath Solutions As Undervalued Narrative Stays In Focus
items.summary: BlackRock (BLK) has put retirement design back in focus after unveiling LifePath Solutions, a customizable target date framework that blends public and private markets, guaranteed income options, and participant level analysis for workplace plans.
